# apple_submit_in_app_purchase (Action)

Submits an in-app purchase's version being prepared to App Review, by adding it to the platform's review submission that is being prepared, or a new one. An app's first in-app purchase must be reviewed with an App Store version: set `submit = false`, then run `apple_submit_for_review`, which adds the version to the same submission and submits both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_submit_in_app_purchase" "coins" {
  config {
    app_id             = data.apple_app.example.id
    in_app_purchase_id = apple_in_app_purchase.coins.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `in_app_purchase_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase, e.g. `apple_in_app_purchase.example.id`.

### Optional

- `platform` (String) Platform of the review submission: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`. Defaults to `IOS`.
- `submit` (Boolean) Whether to submit the review submission. Set it to `false` to add an App Store version to the same submission. Defaults to `true`.
